nodes.description: Public constant string state variable holding the token name 'TrueMoon-FRS'.
Public constant string state variable holding the token symbol 'TRUE'.
Public constant uint8 state variable holding token decimals (0).
Constant uint256 state variable holding the fixed total supply of 1e18.
Mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances of each holder; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 tracking ERC20 allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor that mints the entire totalSupply_ to the pool address _poolAddr.
Pure getter returning the constant totalSupply_.
View getter returning balances[tokenOwner].
Public function transferring numTokens from msg.sender to receiver after a require balance check.
Public function setting allowed[msg.sender][delegate] = numTokens.
View getter returning allowed[owner][delegate].
Public function spending an allowance to move numTokens from owner to buyer.
SafeMath library function performing checked subtraction via assert(b <= a).
SafeMath library function performing checked addition via assert(c >= a).
Caller-controlled address used as the implicit source of transfer/approve and as spender in transferFrom.
balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens) inside transfer - checked subtraction on caller balance.
balances[receiver].add(numTokens) inside transfer - checked addition crediting the receiver.
balances[owner].sub(numTokens) inside transferFrom - checked subtraction on owner balance.
allowed[owner][msg.sender].sub(numTokens) inside transferFrom - checked subtraction of the allowance.
balances[buyer].add(numTokens) inside transferFrom - checked addition crediting the buyer.
Constructor parameter _poolAddr, the address receiving the initial total supply.
transfer parameter receiver, destination address of the tokens.
transfer parameter numTokens, amount to move.
approve parameter delegate, spender being authorized.
approve parameter numTokens, allowance amount to set.
transferFrom parameter owner, account whose balance and allowance are debited.
transferFrom parameter buyer, account credited with the tokens.
transferFrom parameter numTokens, amount to move.
Local variable c = a + b inside SafeMath.add, used for the overflow assertion.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _poolAddr flows into the constructor body as the mint recipient.
Constant totalSupply_ is read by the constructor to mint the initial balance.
Constructor writes balances[_poolAddr] = totalSupply_.
totalSupply() returns the state variable totalSupply_.
balanceOf() reads balances[tokenOwner] from the balances mapping.
transfer uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer parameter receiver flows into the function body.
transfer parameter numTokens flows into the function body.
transfer writes updated values back into the balances mapping.
transfer executes balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens), delegating to SafeMath sub.
balances[msg.sender] is read as the minuend of the subtraction.
msg.sender indexes the balance used in the subtraction operation.
numTokens is the subtrahend applied to the sender balance.
Result of balances[msg.sender].sub(numTokens) is stored back in balances.
transfer executes balances[receiver].add(numTokens), delegating to SafeMath add.
balances[receiver] is read as the addend of the addition.
receiver indexes the balance used in the addition operation.
numTokens is the value added to the receiver balance.
Result of balances[receiver].add(numTokens) is stored back in balances.
approve uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve parameter delegate flows into the function body.
approve parameter numTokens flows into the function body.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][delegate] = numTokens.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses caller-controlled msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[owner][msg.sender].
transferFrom parameter owner flows into the function body.
transferFrom parameter buyer flows into the function body.
transferFrom parameter numTokens flows into the function body.
transferFrom writes updated balances for owner and buyer.
transferFrom writes the decremented allowance back into allowed.
transferFrom executes balances[owner].sub(numTokens) through SafeMath sub.
balances[owner] is read as the minuend of the subtraction.
owner indexes the balance used in the subtraction operation.
numTokens is the subtrahend applied to the owner balance.
Result of balances[owner].sub(numTokens) is stored back in balances.
transferFrom executes allowed[owner][msg.sender].sub(numTokens) through SafeMath sub.
allowed[owner][msg.sender] is read as the minuend of the allowance subtraction.
owner indexes the allowance mapping entry being decremented.
msg.sender indexes the spender entry of the allowance mapping.
numTokens is the subtrahend applied to the allowance.
Result of the allowance subtraction is stored back in allowed.
transferFrom executes balances[buyer].add(numTokens) through SafeMath add.
balances[buyer] is read as the addend of the addition.
buyer indexes the balance credited in the addition.
numTokens is the value added to the buyer balance.
Result of balances[buyer].add(numTokens) is stored back in balances.
The subtraction in transfer is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
The addition in transfer is delegated to SafeMath.add.
The owner-balance subtraction in transferFrom is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
The allowance subtraction in transferFrom is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
The buyer-balance addition in transferFrom is delegated to SafeMath.add.
SafeMath.add computes the local intermediate c = a + b.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _poolAddr only exists to define the mint recipient and can be folded into the constructor node.
receiver is a transfer-local input that is only used to index the balances mapping written by transfer.
numTokens is a transfer-local input consumed by the arithmetic operations executed in transfer.
delegate is only used as a mapping key by approve and carries no independent semantics.
numTokens is only used to set the allowance value written by approve.
owner is a transferFrom-local input used to index balances and allowed.
buyer is a transferFrom-local input used only as the credit destination.
numTokens is a transferFrom-local input consumed by the arithmetic operations.
The temporary c exists only inside SafeMath.add for the overflow assertion and can be merged into add.
